newsitem.title: USA: California Microwave to divest 2 units.
newsitem.headline: California Microwave to divest 2 units.

text.p: California Microwave Inc Wednesday said it intends to sell its Satellite Transmission Systems and Microwave Networks business units and keep its satellite modem and other wireless radio divisions.
In a statement, the company said J.P. Morgan is handling the divestiture.

Satellite Transmission Systems, located in Hauppauge, NY, is a turnkey supplier of satellite communications earth stations and networks. It provides systems engineering and integration capabilities. Microwave Networks, with facilities in Stafford, Texas, and in Chelmsford, Mass., designs and manufactures microwave radio systems for cellular, personal communications services and public and private communications networks.
